title: StateAmendment
description: One state entry of a STATE AMENDMENT block printed in a Central Act section (PROCUREMENT_PLAN §2.2 Table 7), bootstrapped offline from the corpus. Unparsed parts are null; raw_text keeps the entry as printed.

id.description: Deterministic ID {central_act_id}:s{section_slug}:{state_jurisdiction | unmapped}, -2, -3, ... on collision, e.g. A1908-5:s115:IN-UP

central_act_id.description: The amended Central Act, e.g. A1908-5 (CPC)

section_id.description: The sections-table id of the section whose text prints the block

section_number.description: The section the entry says it amends (e.g. 115, 25A); null when not stated

state_name.description: The state name as printed in the entry heading, or in the reference when the entry has no heading

state_jurisdiction.description: jurisdictions.code of the state; null when the name is unknown or ambiguous

state_act_reference.description: The [Vide …] reference as printed, e.g. U.P. Act 31 of 1978, s. 2

amendment_type.description: From the instruction's verbs; null when there is none or several kinds

amended_text.description: The amendment as printed, without the state heading and reference

effective_date.description: A (w.e.f. …) date printed with the reference; else null

valid_to.description: Date the state amendment ceased to apply: the central Act's repeal_date when it is repealed (2024-07-01 for the IPC, CrPC and Evidence Act)

source_url.description: Provenance: a permalink to the frozen v0.1.1 sections-table row the entry was parsed from (the corpus records no per-section portal URL)
